_comment: Naruto / Naruto Shippuden / Boruto collection: shinobi forms. Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. Requested by name: Vulpix line (Ninetales) as Kurama; Xurkitree as Sasuke, an addon line because Cobblemon has no Xurkitree model and the Cobblemon Ultra-Beasts mod provides it (see addon_lines). The other 16 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 16 --seed naruto-shippuden` and dealt round-robin one look each: akatsuki, leaf_shinobi, anbu, sage_mode, uzumaki, byakugan, karma.

addon_lines.requires: Cobblemon: AllTheMons x Mega Showdown or Cobblemon Ultra-Beasts (either provides the Xurkitree model)

readme.title: Naruto / Naruto Shippuden / Boruto (Shinobi)
readme.summary: Pokemon as shinobi, including Kurama and Sasuke.
looks: each other line wears one look: Akatsuki cloak, Leaf Shinobi flak vest, ANBU mask, Sage Mode, Uzumaki orange, Byakugan or a Boruto Karma seal
glowing eyes on the looks that have them (Sharingan, Byakugan, Jougan, toad eyes)

specials.look: Kurama, the Nine-Tails: orange fox fur, black eye markings, red slit eyes and a flickering chakra glow

specials.line: Xurkitree (needs AllTheMons x Mega Showdown or Cobblemon Ultra-Beasts for its model)
specials.look: Sasuke Uchiha: spiky dark hair, glowing Sharingan, the Uchiha crest, and crackling Chidori lightning on both claws
